title: Hanford establishes first ILAW disposal while exact accepted and disposed counts remain separate
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports permanent disposal of the first vitrified low-activity-waste containers and about 30 containers staged for movement; later project minutes report 66 shipped to the disposal facility. Denominator: One first-disposal event, an approximately-30-container ready cohort, and a later 66-container shipped count; readiness, shipment, acceptance, and disposal are preserved as distinct stages.
